heading: INT. WAX MUSEUM - BACK STOREROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. WAX MUSEUM - BACK STOREROOM - NIGHT
Shelves of disembodied heads.
A half-melted Napoleon lies on a cart.
A bucket labelled "SPARE ELVIS."
GREGORY PUFFIN, 50s, the curator, in a velvet jacket two sizes too small, wrings his hands.
MAXINE TAN, 30s, a night guard with a flashlight and a dead-eyed stare.
ULYSSES CRANE, 40s, a restorer in a paint-stained smock, kneels by a headless Churchill.
BABS DELANEY, 60s, the cleaning lady, mops in slow circles.
KOFI BOATENG, 20s, a tour guide in a tricorn hat, holds a tray of sandwiches.
This is a disaster.
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: It's a Tuesday.
units.name: MAXINE

units.text: The Queen is missing.
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: The Queen is always missing. We keep losing her wig.
units.name: ULYSSES

units.text: Not the wig. The QUEEN.
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: Everyone turns.
A single empty pedestal stands in the corner, a velvet rope still looped around it.
I thought she was in the shop.
units.name: BABS

units.text: I thought she was in the Hall of Kings.
units.name: KOFI

units.text: Nobody checked the Hall of Kings.
units.name: MAXINE

units.text: Nobody check ANYTHING. Everyone stay calm.
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: A loud clunk from the ceiling.
A pale shape swings past on a rope.
They scatter, Babs shrieking, Kofi dropping the tray, Ulysses diving behind the cart, Maxine drawing her flashlight like a pistol.
The shape stops dead in the middle of the room, swaying: a wax Queen Elizabeth, hung by her own sash from a rafter.
Silence.
Kofi peers from behind the cart.
Is she... meant to be there?
units.name: KOFI

units.text: It's the best she's looked in years.
units.name: BABS

units.text: Who did this?
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: A muffled giggle from a tall wardrobe.
The door creaks open.
A tiny figure steps out in a toddler's tricorn hat, holding an enormous pair of scissors.
Everyone freezes.
Kofi. Is that your niece?
units.name: GREGORY

units.text: Take-Your-Child-To-Work Day.
units.name: KOFI
